company.name: ActionIQ
company.shortDescription: ActionIQ is a purpose-built enterprise Customer Data Platform solving complex data problems: flow and scale, analytics, and orchestration.
company.description:
ActionIQ is an innovative Enterprise Customer Data Platform for marketers, analysts, and technologists. We move marketing forward through the power of data, insightful analytics, and seamless marketing integration - filling in the white space left by all the Marketing Clouds.The company is dedicated to providing marketers with freedom and speed, scaling to any quantity of customer data. Capture, analyze, and utilize of all your data to build and launch marketing campaigns - without ever calling IT. AIQ is personalized marketing campaigns across all your channels in minutes, not months. 

Based in New York City, we are backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital and FirstMark Capital.

aiResearchSummary.text: ActionIQ is focused on developing systems for data management and analytics. Their research includes query tree labeling and processing, which involves generating identifiers for nodes in a query tree to enhance data flow and scale. They are also working on mutable data ingestion and storage, allowing for the efficient handling of updated data. Additionally, ActionIQ is exploring flexible data ingestion techniques to manage non-standard binary formats and database table annotation processing to improve data orchestration. These efforts highlight ActionIQ's commitment to solving complex data problems in customer data platforms.
